title: Isolated-workspace ownership for spec projections (#1255)
intent: Prevent Decapod from writing .decapod/managed/specs/* from a protected root main/master checkout. Fail closed with workspace_required. Refresh projections only inside a claimed isolated worktree identified by the Git toplevel path. Require those managed spec files in the same PR as the code change that caused them. Restore workspace status to read-only validation as in 0.96.0.
stop_conditions: Do not stash, reset, or rewrite files in the host root checkout as part of the product fix

forbidden_paths: Do not force-push or rewrite shared history
